steps.content: FUN_00101218 is a character-by-character cipher: init value 0x7b1, each step value = (value*7) & 0xffff, char += (value//10)*10 - value
The cipher effectively subtracts (value % 10) from each character
steps.evidence: It looks like basic string encryption... c = c + (number // 10) * 10 - number
